gloss: to cancel; to call off; to abandon (a plan)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {取|と}りやめていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cancel, to call off, to abandon
definitions.explanation: To decide not to go through with a plan, event, or action that was previously intended. Implies a deliberate decision to stop before something has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめた。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめることにした。
examples.english: We decided to call off the game because of rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめざる⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: We had no choice but to abandon the plan due to budget constraints.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめる (abandon a plan)
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめる (cancel a trip)
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめる (call off a game)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りやめる (cancel plans)

USAGE:
Similar to ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}する→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧ but {取|と}りやめる emphasizes the decision-making process of choosing not to proceed. ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}する→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧ is more neutral and can refer to stopping something already in progress, while {取|と}りやめる typically refers to canceling before the event begins. Often written with hiragana ⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧ rather than kanji ⟦{止|や}める→止む：01153_yamu⟧.
